description.value: Yale Library is a small public branch of the Fraser Valley Regional Library system, situated in the historic village of Yale along the Fraser Canyon — a corridor popular with touring cyclists. Part of a 25-branch regional network, it offers free public computers and WiFi alongside a children's space and accessible facilities. For cyclists passing through this otherwise sparse stretch of Highway 1, it provides a rare opportunity for a rest, connectivity, and a 24-hour item return drop box.
